about: Tobler's go-to global services. Two kinds: services Tobler calls directly (because the atlas doesn't hold them, or holds only a copy with a worse licence), and trusted publishers whose own atlas records are ranked first. Edit by hand; each entry says where its licence comes from. Started 17 Nov 2026.

services.title: Active fires and thermal hotspots, VIIRS 375 m (NASA FIRMS)
services.licence: Free and open under NASA's Earth science data policy; cite NASA FIRMS
services.attribution: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System), VIIRS 375 m active fire product (S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21)
services.note: Satellite detections of heat, at about 375 m: fires, gas flares, industrial heat. Positions are pixel centres. Shows what was detected in the days asked (up to 5, NASA's limit), not a long record.

services.title: Active fires and thermal hotspots, MODIS 1 km (NASA FIRMS)
services.licence: Free and open under NASA's Earth science data policy; cite NASA FIRMS
services.attribution: NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System), MODIS Collection 6.1 active fire product
services.note: Coarser (1 km) than VIIRS; the longer-running record. Use VIIRS first.

publishers.about: Atlas records whose publisher matches one of these are marked trusted and ranked first. National and intergovernmental bodies with a global or regional remit; national mapping and environment agencies are already ranked first by publisher type.

baseline_about: Layers every NTR screen checks before the analyst starts (18 Nov 2026, Rob's call), so the essentials don't depend on a lucky text search. Each applies where its 'where' box and 'setting' say ('sea': offshore or within reach of the coast; 'any'). Ids are AI Living World Atlas records; all tested to return features on 18 Nov. Boundaries are checked separately (js/boundaries.js). KBAs aren't here: the IBAT licence doesn't allow it.

baseline.title: World Database on Protected Areas (European seas and coasts, via EMODnet)
baseline.publisher: EMODnet Human Activities (data: UNEP-WCMC and IUCN)
baseline.licence: WDPA terms: no commercial use without a licence from UNEP-WCMC (data via EMODnet, CC-BY 4.0)
baseline.for: protected areas (marine and coastal; non-CDDA countries)
baseline.note: Left out unless non-commercial data is switched on in settings.

baseline.title: Nationally designated areas (CDDA)
baseline.licence: © European Environment Agency (EEA reuse policy: attribution)
baseline.for: nationally designated protected areas in Europe

baseline.title: Natura 2000: Habitats Directive Sites (pSCI, SCI or SAC)
baseline.for: EU Natura 2000 habitat sites (not UK sites since 2021)

baseline.title: Natura 2000: Birds Directive Sites (SPA)
baseline.for: EU Natura 2000 bird sites (not UK sites since 2021)

baseline.title: IUCN Important Marine Mammal Areas
baseline.publisher: UN Environment Programme World Conservation Monitoring Centre
baseline.licence: IUCN Joint SSC/WCPA Marine Mammal Protected Areas Task Force: check terms before commercial use

baseline.title: Global Distribution of Coral Reefs (2003)
baseline.publisher: UN Environment Programme World Conservation Monitoring Centre
baseline.licence: UNEP-WCMC (2003): check terms before commercial use

baseline.title: Special Areas under MARPOL
baseline.publisher: UN Environment Programme World Conservation Monitoring Centre (data: IMO)
baseline.licence: International Maritime Organization: check terms before commercial use

baseline.title: Critical Habitat Areas by NMFS
baseline.licence: US federal government work: public domain
baseline.for: ESA critical habitat in US waters and coasts

values_about: Raster services the screening baseline reads values from (js/seavalues.js): water depth and AIS vessel traffic. Called directly from the page (both send CORS headers). Added 19 Nov 2026; to be swapped for atlas records once the atlas tags value-returning services (request in docs/atlas-requests.md).

depth.title: DEM Global Mosaic (bathymetry and topography)
depth.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)
depth.licence: US federal government data (NOAA NCEI): public domain in the US (inferred; not stated on the service). Built from GEBCO and other sources, which keep their own attribution
depth.licence_source: inferred: US federal work (17 U.S.C. §105); the service description gives no licence
depth.attribution: NOAA NCEI DEM Global Mosaic (includes GEBCO Compilation Group data)
depth.note: Pixel values in metres relative to sea level (negative below). Cell size varies by source: about 460 m (GEBCO) in open ocean, finer where NOAA holds surveys.

traffic.title: Vessel Density, annual averages (EMODnet Human Activities)
traffic.publisher: EMODnet Human Activities (Cogea Srl), from AIS by CLS, ORBCOMM and vesseltracker.com
traffic.attribution: EMODnet Human Activities, Vessel Density (Cogea Srl), AIS data from CLS, ORBCOMM and vesseltracker.com
traffic.coverage_note: EMODnet's vessel density covers EU waters and neighbouring seas only
traffic.note: Hours spent by vessels per km² a month, 1 km cells. 2023 is used: EMODnet notes 2024 lost satellite AIS data from June.
